roles_en: Parliament secretary of the Republic of Armenia
bio_en: Hakob Ter-Hakobian, pen-name Irazek, was a philologist and educator born in 1881 and a veteran ARF member. During the First World War, in 1916-17, he served in the Caucasus, and from 1917 devoted himself to national and educational work; he became secretary of the parliament of the Republic of Armenia and a member of its last government. In emigration he was inspector of Armenian schools in Iran until 1934 and of the national schools of Baghdad from 1946 to 1950, later teaching in Abadan. He died suddenly in Tehran on 19 June 1953 at the age of 72.
